definition: the tapestry maximum, and who it keeps from being scored on a present state

settled:
Weight is the maximum the whole tapestry attains, so the capacity need only be present at some identity-instant rather than at the instant being judged.

An infant carries the maximum their tapestry reaches. So does someone who cannot read their own states, and so does someone whose thinking was compromised after the fact.

Acquired damage cannot lower it, because the maximum reaches back to when the capacity was there.

That existential quantifier is the working part of the rule. Without it the measure would score a being on the state that being happens to be in rather than on the being.
